newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 63 bln dmk repos, adds funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 63 bln dmk repos, adds funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it had awarded 63 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent.

The central bank accepted 29.50 percent of the bids for the 14-day funds. A repo pact for 62.2 billion marks at a fixed three percent rate expires today, Wednesday, so a net 800 million marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 213.6 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The repo rate has been fixed at 3.00 percent since last August.
